title: DNSSEC
subtitle: Sign {zone}, manage keys, and publish DS records to the parent zone
pemSecret: A PEM private key is highly sensitive: it is sent once with this request and is never cached, logged, or echoed back.

status.label: Signing status
status.unsignedHint: DNSSEC is not enabled for this zone; responses will not contain signatures.
status.signedHint: Zone is signed; responses include RRSIG and DNSKEY records.
status.pendingHint: Signing is in progress; refresh later to see the result.
status.disabledHint: The server has disabled DNSSEC for this zone; signing and key operations are unavailable.

overview.title: Overview
overview.zoneDisabled: This zone is currently disabled; DNSSEC operations will not take effect.

sign.title: Sign zone
sign.subtitle: Generate key pairs and sign the entire zone
sign.algorithmHelp: ECDSA P256 and Ed25519 produce smaller signatures with faster verification and broad compatibility.
sign.hashAlgorithmHelp: Only required when using an RSA algorithm.
sign.keySizeHelp: Larger keys are more secure but produce larger signatures and responses.
sign.curveHelp: ECDSA supports P256 / P384; EdDSA supports Ed25519 / Ed448.
sign.pemHelp: Leave blank to let the server generate a new key pair. Only paste if you already have keys.
sign.pemInvalid: Invalid PEM format; must start with -----BEGIN ... PRIVATE KEY-----
sign.dnsKeyTtlHelp: While the parent holds the DS record, this TTL determines how long to wait during key rollover.
sign.nxProofHelp: NSEC exposes all names in the zone; NSEC3 uses hashing to prevent zone enumeration.
sign.iterationsHelp: More iterations increase offline brute-force resistance but add signing and validation overhead.
sign.saltLengthHelp: 8 bytes is usually sufficient; enter 0 for no salt.
sign.warning: Signing generates DNSKEY, RRSIG, and NSEC/NSEC3 records, significantly increasing zone size.
sign.requiresPrimary: Only Primary zones can be signed.

unsign.title: Unsign zone
unsign.confirm: Remove DNSSEC signatures from {zone}? All signatures and DNSKEY records will be deleted.
unsign.warning: If the parent zone still holds DS records, unsigning will cause resolution failures. Remove the DS records at your registrar first and wait for their TTL to expire.

keys.title: Private key management
keys.subtitle: View, roll over, and delete signing keys
keys.publishAllSuccess: Generated keys published as DNSKEY records
keys.publishAllHint: Newly generated keys must be published before resolvers can see them.

stateHints.Generated: Key generated but not yet published as a DNSKEY record.
stateHints.Published: DNSKEY published; waiting for the old key's TTL to fully expire.
stateHints.Ready: Ready for use; waiting for the activation time.
stateHints.Active: Currently used to sign zone data.
stateHints.Retiring: No longer signing, but still published so resolvers can transition.
stateHints.Retired: No longer published; safe to delete.

keys.activateKskHint: Only activate after confirming the parent zone has received the DS record; otherwise resolution will fail.
keys.retireHint: Stops signing with this key but keeps it published until the TTL expires.
keys.rolloverHint: Generates a new key and begins retiring the current one.
keys.deleteConfirm: Delete the private key with tag {keyTag}? If still in use, the zone will fail to sign.
keys.rolloverDaysHelp: Enter 0 to disable automatic rollover for this key.
keys.empty: No signing keys for this zone yet
keys.emptyHint: KSK and ZSK are generated automatically after signing the zone.
keys.pemHelp: Leave blank to let the server generate a key.

ds.title: DS records
ds.subtitle: Submit the following to your registrar or parent zone administrator to establish the DNSSEC chain of trust
ds.emptyHint: The zone is unsigned, or the KSK has not been published yet.
ds.notSigned: This zone is not signed; DS records cannot be generated.
ds.registrarHint: Most registrars accept key tag / algorithm / digest type / digest. Copy the BIND format below to submit directly.
ds.waitHint: DS record propagation typically takes hours to days, depending on the parent zone's TTL.

nsec3.title: Non-existence proof
nsec3.subtitle: Switch between NSEC and NSEC3, or adjust NSEC3 parameters
nsec3.nsecHint: NSEC is simple but allows anyone to enumerate all names in the zone.
nsec3.nsec3Hint: NSEC3 hashes names with a salt to prevent zone enumeration, at higher computational cost.
nsec3.confirmConvert: During conversion the zone is briefly unverifiable. Perform this during off-peak hours.

dnsKeyTtl.title: DNSKEY TTL
dnsKeyTtl.label: TTL (seconds)
dnsKeyTtl.help: After changing the TTL, wait for the old value to expire before performing a KSK rollover.
